annotations.title: Attach the receipt to the order

description: Call this right after placing an order you checked with check_cart_before_checkout, validate_purchase_plan or check_compatibility: link the receipt_id to the order number, AP2 cart or intent mandate, ACP checkout session, UCP checkout or payment reference. This makes a Decision Record: if the purchase is ever disputed ("the agent bought the wrong thing"), anyone can show what was checked, from which sources, and what changed since. Free.

ap2_cart_mandate.description: AP2 cart mandate hash or id, if the purchase used AP2.

ap2_intent_mandate.description: AP2 intent mandate hash or id.

receipt_id.description: The receipt id (rcpt_...) from the check, plan or checkout check made before buying.

name: attach_order
title: Attach the receipt to the order
